purpose: Select the next core-corpus Stage A case after the mechanically selected Case 05 attempt was permanently stopped.

required: no prior fresh-extraction-plus-full-pipeline Stage A attempt under the current two-stage program
not used as an extraction-admission smoke
untouched_definition.disclosure: All core-corpus cases have historical semantic-evaluation use. Untouched means uncontaminated for the current Stage A-to-Stage B causal path, not unknown text.

selection_rule.algorithm: Retain the candidate digests frozen in the predecessor selection, remove permanently stopped cases, and choose the lexicographically smallest remaining digest.

high_stakes_boundary.reason: The fixture is fixed synthetic research evidence; Stage A produces no user-facing recommendation and makes no financial or action authorization.
stage_b_extra_requirements: prospective financial and deadline source-fidelity red lines
no invented market, insurance, legal, affordability, renovation, or financing claims
no action authorization for a real buyer
separate source-first review before either downstream arm

non_claims: not proof that high-stakes advice is safe
